answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments with five LLMs on five benchmarks to validate the generalizability of MARKERGEN, covering cross-task (summarization, story generation, QA, heuristic generation)...

answer_2.quote: We use GPT-4o mini as the judge to evaluate text quality, reporting S (quality score) and E (length error rate). We also define Precise Match (PM) and Flexible Match (FM) as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the pairwise evaluation framework from AlpacaEval 2.0, using GPT-4o-mini as the automatic judge. We also complement our main evaluation protocol with a win-rate based assessment and multi-LLM judgment analysis.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human agreement study. We randomly sampled 200 pairwise comparisons and observed a strong Spearman's correlation ... indicating high consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Randomly sample pairwise comparisons and compute Spearman's correlation between human annotations and LLM judgments.
